verdict.summary: Round 7 remains correct and complete on the diff-scoped evidence. The refactor preserves the v1 relation while sharing graph re-commitment and per-pair checks; join_eq_r_check re-commits both graphs once and applies presence, slot equality, and per-lane commitment binding to every lane. JR2 uses an explicitly one-pair committed universe and genuinely exercises repeated-pair padding with independent blinders, while JR3-JR6 cover forged equality, graph substitution, phantom rows, and cross-lane commitment swaps. The documentation consistently limits the result to fixed-shape padding, makes R public, disclaims distinctness and cardinality bounds, and preserves the not-yet-sound/external-audit caveat. The generated benchmark metadata is internally consistent. No hostile instruction directed at the reviewer was detected.
